title: CloudGoat: EC2 SSRF
description: A CloudGoat scenario by Rhino Security Labs, deployed into your own AWS account: starting as the IAM user Solus, read a Lambda function's hardcoded secrets, exploit an SSRF in a web application on EC2 to take the instance's keys from the metadata service, then use keys found in a private S3 bucket to invoke the function.
question: Starting as the IAM user Solus, invoke the scenario's Lambda function.
